card.name: Montenegrin Oro
card.profile: Crnogorsko oro is the Montenegrin national folk dance of the Dinaric Western Balkans; "oro" derives from "orao" (eagle), referencing dancers’ eagle-like movements. Young men and women form a singing circle while a man enters to dance like an eagle, joined by a woman; the gallery praises or mocks the performers. Performed without instruments (singing only), it characteristically ends with men forming a two-story human circle by standing on each other’s shoulders. Variants: Crmničko, Zetsko, Katunsko, Riječko.
card.insight: Ethnochoreologist Davor Sedlarević led revitalization of 30+ rural dances; 14 (incl. oro variants) were declared national intangible heritage in 2016.
